name: Solar Shield
body:
School evocation [fire, light]; Level arcanist 6, cleric 5, oracle 5, sorcerer 6, paladin 4, wizard 6, warpriest 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M/DF (a pinch of magnesium)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 round/level (D)

DESCRIPTION

This spell works as the warm shield version of the fire shield, except the flames are golden, increasing the light level up to bright light. Half the damage dealt by this spell is fire damage, and the other half results directly from divine power and is therefore not subject to being reduced by resistance to fire-based attacks. Any creature taking damage from this spell must succeed at a Reflex saving throw or be blinded for 1 round and affected as if exposed to 1 round of natural sunlight.
